recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future changes are needed to the assembler or composer code definitions, they should be handled in THO rather than by reintroducing retired inline terminology in core FHIR.
issue_request: FHIR-8595 was a Published/Persuasive Security WG request to add assembler and composer to the Provenance participant-role vocabulary, using definitions from HL7 v3 ParticipationFunction.
initial_application: Git history shows same-day 2015 application and correction: 1ca8cc96 added assembler and composer to the Provenance spreadsheet, and 102e7011 moved them into the Provenance agent-role value set with the requested definitions after the Jira comment noted they were initially put in the wrong place.
additional_context: The old inline core vocabulary has been refactored. Provenance is still active in source/fhir.ini, Provenance.agent.type binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/participation-role-type, and that source value set includes http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/provenance-agent-type. The referenced THO code system contains assembler and composer. Later FHIR-32519 narrowed participation-role-type but explicitly retained provenance-participant-type codes including Assembler and Composer.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is appropriate because the current build-scope core source and referenced THO terminology already satisfy the issue; duplicating the external terminology in core would be a regression.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Provenance.agent.type decision simplified participation-role-type while preserving provenance-participant-type codes including Assembler and Composer.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Security WG request to add assembler and composer to the Provenance participant-role vocabulary.
